text:
- **Go-only pm:** Go pm is now the only pm, and both clones run it. Project tracking moved to the public pm repository, with its full history.
- **Release notes:** Go pm shipped as a release with a breaking change. Every release now has a changelog note, and CI refuses a change without one.
- **Site and record fixes:** The site no longer shows "no such file" errors while git rewrites records. Wide diagrams scroll on phones, and images kept beside a record now display.
- **Faster, steadier checks:** The slowest pm CI check now takes a fraction of its former time. The Dolt crash in garbage-collection tests is fixed; the cause was in Dolt itself.
